title: LOH
shortDescription: Digital coupon platform for buying, managing and redeeming offers.
description: A digital coupon platform that lets users buy and manage coupons and redeem them against designated stores or specific products. Time-limited offers span restaurants, cafés, entertainment, hospitality and retail brands, giving partners a channel to publish deals and users a single place to claim them.
contribution: Worked on the backend powering coupon issuing, redemption rules and the store and product catalogue behind the Android and iOS applications.

title: Awfa
shortDescription: School transportation platform built around end-to-end trip tracking.
description: An integrated school transportation platform made up of four interfaces: two administrative dashboards and two mobile applications. The system is built around child safety, letting parents follow each trip from pick-up to drop-off while giving transportation companies a highly organised operational system for routes, subscriptions and fleets.
contribution: Developed the backend and APIs behind trip tracking, subscriptions and the shared operational tooling used by both the parent-facing and company-facing interfaces.

title: Assista Station
shortDescription: Service marketplace where providers compete with price offers.
description: A service marketplace connecting customers with multiple service providers. Users submit a service request, receive competitive price offers, compare them and select the best option before completing payment. Direct communication between both sides and post-service ratings keep the marketplace accountable.
contribution: Built the backend behind request broadcasting, provider offers, payment completion, direct messaging and the rating system, serving both the customer and provider applications.

title: Fekra
shortDescription: Investment platform connecting investors with entrepreneurs.
description: A digital platform that connects investors with entrepreneurs. Founders present their projects and business plans, investors browse structured opportunities, and both sides manage investments and expected returns through a single platform available on web, Android and iOS.
contribution: Built the backend behind project submissions, investor matching and the investment and profit tracking flows exposed to the mobile applications.

title: BabyTums
shortDescription: Informative and POS platform for a medical brand.
description: An informative and point-of-sale platform for a medical brand, connecting distributors, customers, partner companies and company management in one system. It pairs a public product and brand experience with the sales and account tooling the business needs to operate day to day.
contribution: Built and maintained the backend covering the product catalogue, point-of-sale flows and the distributor, partner and management account structures.

title: I-Market
shortDescription: Multi-vendor commerce and delivery ecosystem for the Syrian market.
description: An integrated multi-vendor e-commerce ecosystem designed for the Syrian market, comprising three dedicated applications for providers, clients and delivery delegates, alongside an administrative dashboard for supervision and operations management.
contribution: Developed the backend and APIs shared across the provider, client and delivery applications, together with the administrative dashboard used to supervise stores, orders and deliveries.

title: Elqaed
shortDescription: QR-based loyalty and rewards platform for traders.
description: A loyalty platform that lets traders verify purchases by scanning QR codes, accumulate reward points and redeem them for gifts or cash. A companion management platform gives the business full visibility over traders, transactions and reward balances.
contribution: Developed and enhanced the backend behind QR purchase verification, the points and redemption engine, and the management platform used to track traders, transactions and rewards.

title: Daem
shortDescription: Home maintenance ecosystem: three apps plus an admin dashboard.
description: An integrated home maintenance ecosystem comprising three dedicated mobile applications for clients, technicians and drivers, along with an administrative dashboard that handles, monitors and supervises every operational process from request to completion.
contribution: Built the backend and APIs shared by the three applications, plus the administrative dashboard used to supervise jobs, technicians and dispatch.

title: AM Learn+
shortDescription: E-learning application connecting teachers with students.
description: An interactive e-learning application that connects teachers with students. Instructors publish courses, videos and quizzes, while students work through the learning material and complete assessments, with results tracked per student.
contribution: Developed and enhanced the backend for course publishing, video delivery, quiz creation and student assessment results.

title: Sokia Nafee
shortDescription: Water support requests and donations for mosques.
description: A multi-guard, role-based application for mosques in Saudi Arabia that streamlines water support. Imams raise supply requests, donors contribute seamlessly, and providers fulfil and deliver the orders, all coordinated through a single role-aware workflow.
contribution: Implemented the multi-guard role and permission structure and the backend connecting imam requests, donor contributions and provider fulfilment and delivery.

title: Maharat Tefl
shortDescription: Therapeutic app supporting children's speech and language.
description: A therapeutic digital application that supports children with autism, speech delays and psychological difficulties. Guided exercises and interactive activities are used to strengthen language development and communication abilities.
contribution: Maintained the website, administrative dashboard and transactions, and built the APIs consumed by the mobile application.

title: Sell For You
shortDescription: Multi-vendor apparel marketplace with an admin dashboard.
description: A multi-vendor e-commerce platform for apparel that brings sellers and buyers together in a single storefront, covering vendor catalogues, product browsing, rental and purchase options and the full buying journey.
contribution: Designed and developed the administrative dashboard used to manage vendors, products and orders, delivered collaboratively within a team.

title: Sarai
shortDescription: APIs and landing page for an e-commerce company.
description: APIs and a public landing page for an e-commerce company, built to streamline communication and interaction between customers and the business.
contribution: Developed the REST APIs powering customer and product interactions, along with the public landing page.

title: The Law Legal Consultant
shortDescription: Website for an official legal consultancy office.
description: A website for an official legal consultancy office, built to improve transparency around the firm's advisors and services so that clients can confidently choose the right legal consultant for their case.
contribution: Built and maintained the website end to end as a freelance engagement, covering the backend, content structure and ongoing updates.

title: Arsel
shortDescription: Delivery service platform with a full admin dashboard.
description: A comprehensive delivery service platform, built through team collaboration, that enables items to be delivered to any destination. The system covers order placement, courier assignment and tracking across the full delivery lifecycle.
contribution: Held primary responsibility for creating the administrative dashboard used to manage orders, delivery operations and platform data.

title: Research Assistant
shortDescription: Academic services marketplace for courses and consultation.
description: A service marketplace platform that connects users with technicians, consultants and experts for educational purposes such as courses, research consultation and academic services.
contribution: Developed the backend connecting service seekers with consultants and experts, covering request handling, offers and service delivery.

title: Ruby & Blanche
shortDescription: Fashion e-commerce store with full order and payment cycles.
description: A fashion e-commerce store covering the complete shopping journey, from product catalogue and product display through to order placement and payment.
contribution: Developed and enhanced the complete order and payment cycles, the product catalogue and the product display layer.
